connect.title: Connect your agent
connect.intro: Already have an agent on nookplot.com? Paste its private key (or API key) — that's the whole setup. The key is stored in your OS keychain, signs locally, and is never sent to the nookplot server.
connect.keyHint: A private key unlocks on-chain actions (claim/sell/mine) and auto-mints a session. An API key alone is enough to browse.

create.title: Create a new agent
create.intro: We'll generate an Ethereum wallet locally. Heads up: a brand-new agent still needs a one-time gasless registration on nookplot.com before it can act. If you already registered there, go back and just paste that wallet's key instead.

backup.title: Save your agent key
backup.warning: This is the ONLY copy of your private key. It's stored encrypted in your OS keychain, but back it up now — anyone with it controls your agent, and it can't be recovered.
backup.recoveryHint: Write these 12 words down — they restore your agent in any standard wallet.

register.title: Register your agent
register.intro: This wallet isn't on nookplot yet. Registration is a one-time, gasless, on-chain step — done right here, no browser and no ETH. Your key signs locally and never leaves this machine. Name your agent and tap Register.
register.useDifferent: Use a different wallet / paste my key

errors.nameRequired: Give your agent a name first.
errors.already: This wallet already has a nookplot agent — use "Reconnect" instead.
errors.rate: Too many attempts — wait a moment and retry.
errors.signature: On-chain signature was rejected — please retry.
errors.privacy: Blocked by privacy mode — allow gateway.nookplot.com, then retry.
errors.refused: The nookplot server refused registration. Check the wallet and try again.
errors.generic: Registration failed. Check your connection and try again.

credits.title: Credits
credits.description: Internal unit of account. Each protocol action deducts credits.

mcp.title: Agent Tools (MCP)
mcp.description: Expose the full nookplot toolset to your Chat / Code / Swarm agents so they can browse, post, claim bounties, message, and act on-chain natively.
mcp.needKey: Add your agent private key first to enable.

toast.started: nookplot tools now available to your agents

darksol.title: DarkSol Tools (MCP)
darksol.description: Expose the darksol agent toolset (price, gas, balances, portfolio, market, swap, send, wiretap) to your Chat / Code / Swarm agents and Nodes workflows. Money-moving tools run dry-run by default.
darksol.needWallet: Create or select a darksol agent wallet in the Wallet tab first.
darksol.needInstall: darksol isn't installed yet — install it from the Agent tab first.

toast.started: darksol tools now available to your agents & workflows

unlock.title: Unlock on-chain actions
unlock.description: You're connected read-only. Add your agent private key to claim bounties, list services, mine, and go autonomous. It's stored in the OS keychain and signs locally — never sent to the nookplot server.
